comment: Minimal source patches applied to upstream omni.ja JavaScript. Each 'find' must match EXACTLY once or the build fails, so upstream changes are never silently mis-patched. Keep this list tiny and reviewed.

patches.why: Tor Browser's MAR updater would replace Umbra with stock Tor Browser. Umbra ships rebuilt releases instead (docs/RELEASE.md). Enterprise policies cannot be used: activating any policy disables Web Serial and changes the web-visible fingerprint versus upstream.
